report:
The prior head exists. Diff the two heads to see what changed since round 47.

I found no defect in this change that the author must fix before merge. I didn't have enough time to fully clear it, though. I read the code that changed since round 47 (head `2e9c2ac3`) and ran one probe of the new copier. I didn't run the new session-scoped registrations or any of the UI fixes through a real `AgentSession`.

NO DEFECTS

## NOT A DEFECT

**What I reviewed.** I compared the round-47 head with this one directly; both snapshots are under `heads/`. Only 15 source and doc files changed: `boundary-data.ts`, `loader.ts`, `runner.ts`, `context-surfaces.ts`, `callback-ownership.ts`, `compact-handler.ts`, `managed-timers.ts`, `types.ts`, `model-registry.ts`, `extension-ui-controller.ts`, `session-maintenance.ts`, `provider-gate.ts`, `renderer-scope.ts`, `docs/extensions.md` and the coding-agent `CHANGELOG.md`. The delta is saved as `scratch/delta.diff`.

**The probe.** `scratch/copier.test.ts`, run from `packages/coding-agent`: 4 pass, 0 fail.
- A 50,000-level chain copies whole: `{"depth":50000,"leaf":true,"distinct":true}`.
- An error whose `cause` getter throws a host error: the copy is the outer `Error` with no `cause`, and the host error never escapes.
- A getter that returns a fresh object on every read: stops after about 1.07 s with `RangeError: … holds more than 1000000 objects`.
- A copied `AbortSignal` aborts with a copy of the reason: `{"aborted":true,"same":false}`.

**Earlier findings: status at this head**

| Earlier finding | Status | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Claude 1: the 512-level depth limit breaks `getTree()` and `context` | **Closed** | The copy no longer recurses, and the limit is now 1,000,000 objects instead of 512 levels. Measured above. |
| Claude 2: a disposed session's `ctx.ui` text calls still write to the live UI | **Closed** (code read) | `text()` now always goes through `copiedIn` → `runOwned`, which refuses once the session has gone. |
| Claude 3: `onHandle` receives the host's live `OverlayHandle` | **Closed** (code read) | It now gets its own handle from `handOverlayHandle`. Un-hiding works only while the session is live. |
| Claude 4: an extension can rewrite the abort `reason` the host keeps | **Closed** (copier path measured, rest code read) | All three paths now hand a copy: `AdmittedSignal` (via `gate.hand`), `copyHostData`, and the TUI's `scopedSignal`. |
| Claude 5: `setEditorComponent` gets the raw editor theme | **Closed** (code read) | It now gets `copyHostData(theme)`. |
| Claude 6: a timer scheduled after the shutdown sweep runs for the next session | **Closed** (code read) | `ManagedTimers` now ties each callback to its session when it is scheduled, not when it fires. |
| Claude 7: provider gates, contexts and renderer scopes are per runtime and come back to life for the next session | **Closed** (code read) | Each session now gets its own owner object (`forSession`/`forAcceptance`). Contexts, facades and UI are cached per session, and the renderer scope is pinned per session. |
| Astra 1: a late dialog still runs its option callbacks; nested factories lose their pin | **Closed** (code read) | The option callbacks belong to the session that opened the dialog. The controller refuses a component that arrives after its session has gone, before `overlayOptions` or `onHandle` run. Nested factories are live only while both sessions are (`bothScopes`). |
| Astra 2: `ctx.compact` callbacks receive the host's objects | **Closed** (code read) | Callback arguments are copied in `session-maintenance.ts`, and a thrown error is copied in `compact-handler.ts`. |
| Astra 3: an error getter that throws leaks a host error | **Closed** (measured) | Properties are read with `readQuietly`, and `fromHost` swaps a failed copy for an error of its own. |

**Suspicions I ruled out**
- **`AdmittedSignal`'s new `reason()` has no try/catch.** `followWithCopiedReason` and `copiedReason` have one. If copying the reason threw, the listener would throw and the admitted signal would never abort. That only happens with a reason over a million objects or one with a throwing own getter. The host's real reasons copy cleanly: the plain `{kind:"tool-scoped-abort",…}` record, the Symbol reasons (passed through as-is) and native errors. So I can't show any impact.
- **A session's identity leaking into host code.** The session tag rides along with async work, so host code started from an extension handler carries that handler's session. It only matters when a later `AgentSession` reuses the same runtime. No production path does that: the session claim is held for the whole `AgentSession`, ACP loads extensions fresh for each session, and the CLI runs one session. Only SDK embedders reuse a runtime, which is what the docs describe.
- **Withdrawing a provider by registrant** (`sameRegistrant`) only removes registrations made by the same runtime. A sibling runtime's registrations and host registrations (which have no gate) are left alone.
- **The new copier's output** keeps the old behaviour for dropped functions, array slots, map and set entries, `__proto__` keys, cycles, and copies made by declared shape.
- **The late-dialog refusal** in `showHookCustom` runs after the `closed` branch and before anything of the component is mounted. Not disposing a component from a dead session is consistent with that branch.
